en: Black-and-white postcard showing the ornate facade of a baroque‑revival theatre with two tower statues and the inscription 'TEATRUL NATIONAL' over the main arch. A curved driveway, steps, and small garden are in front with pedestrians walking. The reverse has Romanian postcard layout, the publisher 'EDITURA MERIDIANE', price in lei, and a multilingual caption identifying the building as the National Theatre in Cluj.
